title: Public debt and sustainability
quote: Debt, not deficit, is now the fiscal anchor

boxes.title: Sustainability & borrowing
items: **Debt trap**: borrowing to pay interest on past debt
**r - g**: g > r → debt-GDP falls; r > g → primary surplus needed
Effective interest **7.12%** vs nominal growth **10%**; interest ≈ **40%** of revenue receipts
==Market borrowings = biggest capital receipt== (APPSC-G2 2008)
2026-27 gross market borrowing **₹17.20 lakh crore**; WAM **19.03 years**
External: mostly ==**non-sovereign**==; **ADB** largest multilateral (**32.8%**)

boxes.title: State debt (Art. 293)
items: Borrow ==only within India==; Centre's consent if owing Centre
**SDLs**; external loans via Centre since **2005-06**
16th Finance Commission: State FD cap **3% of GSDP** (2026-31)
Highest debt-GSDP: ==**Punjab 42.9%**== > WB 38.3% > Rajasthan 37.9%

boxes.title: Off-budget borrowing
items: PSU/SPV loans **serviced from budget**, not in deficit
==**FCI from NSSF**== for food subsidy; ended **Budget 2021-22**
FRBM: new guarantees ≤ **0.5% of GDP** a year
AP off-budget **₹1.28 lakh crore (9.7% of GSDP)**; guarantees **₹1,77,328 crore**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Internal debt component = ==**market loans**== (APPSC-G2 2017); small savings, PF = other liabilities
Not all external debt in US dollars (UPSC 2019)
Largest external component historically: **commercial borrowings** (UPPSC 2017)
**State Provident Fund** = part of **Public Account**
Highest debt-GSDP = Punjab, not Kerala or WB
